name: nikarus!
detailed_description:
True love can only exist when built on trust. This game offers a unique co-op adventure where two players must work together to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and find their way through a world full of surprises.

The characters must learn to trust each other. But this journey is not just a physical challenge—it’s an emotional test as well. As past wounds, fears, bottled-up emotions, and insecurities rise to the surface, they will realize that the only way forward is to face them together.

Every level is filled with unique adventures. You’ll laugh through unexpected moments, solve wild puzzles, and sometimes confront challenges that will make you truly feel the meaning of love, friendship, and commitment.

With its captivating story, creative gameplay, and immersive atmosphere, this game delivers an unforgettable cooperative experience. If you’re ready for an adventure where trust is tested, friendships are strengthened, and success is only possible together, this journey awaits you!

nikarus! was developed entirely by a single person. Every detail —including the story, gameplay, visuals, animations, and music— was crafted with a singular vision and deep passion.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
